rows.name: Search Groups
rows.description: Define groups of layers that can be searched together with a shared search construct.

components.name: Search Groups
components.description: Each group bundles layers under a shared name and search construct for cross-layer searching.

object.name: Group Name
object.description: Display name for this search group (e.g., "Geodatasets", "Vectors")

object.name: Search Construct
object.description: Search fields template, e.g. "(name) (category)". Used in regular search mode.

object.name: Layers
object.description: Select which layers belong to this search group.
